text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngh, aah~~~...!! I couldn't reach her...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It's so frustrating! Frustrating, so 
frustrating! ...But—)
(Oooohhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Craaaft!! That was one 
incredible challenge!! You looked so 
cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You showed us the true pride of a Tiara 
Umamusume! What a run, Rhein Kraft---!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!! ...Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(What I wanted to show... I'm sure of it. 
I really showed it to them!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Good work, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah! Heart-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Hey, Mr. Heart.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Would you... shake hands with me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh. —Sure!

The new era of Tiara Umamusume praised 
each other's efforts. Moved by a scene so 
full of hope, the spectators gave them 
their heartfelt applause.
(Clap clap clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. You've really done it this 
time, Craft—

"...And so, the tumultuous days settled 
down for the time being—"

On a day off, I brought Rhein Kraft along 
to a certain place.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't this place...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Of course~! This is where we went for a 
walk the day I first met you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We'd sunbathe together. And then, we'd 
chase after the kitty we met in the 
park..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how nostalgic~. The flowers are just 
as lovely as ever, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Still, what made you come here all of a 
sudden?
choice_data_list: There's something I want to give you.
There's something I want to give you.

text_block_list.text:
I obtained permission from the park 
management beforehand. I guide Rhein Kraft 
into the flower field.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Crouch down? ...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Smells so good...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!? Huh, what!? Wh-What on earth 
is all this!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A flower crown... Could this be... the 
Trainer's!?
choice_data_list:
I tried making this... sorry if it's a bit 
weird.

I tried making this... sorry if it's a bit 
weird.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! It's not weird at all, it's 
beautiful! It's super cute!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still, why—
choice_data_list: I wanted to give you the Tiara.
I wanted to give you the Tiara.

text_block_list.text:
She made her choice and moved forward. 
Even if it meant turning her back on what 
she once longed for.

"I understand your resolve and 
determination, of course... but that is 
precisely why."
choice_data_list:
I wanted to give you a tiara of your very 
own.

I wanted to give you a tiara meant only 
for you.

text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to bless that path with all 
my heart—as best as I possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I really admired it. That tiara you get 
as a supplementary prize, awarded only to 
the girls who win a Triple Tiara race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's really beautiful. An elegant design 
with just a single gemstone, ...but.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want this one. This one is the absolute 
best!

Rhein Kraft gave a ticklish laugh. Under 
the clear, bright sunlight, adorned by the 
radiance of the blooming flowers, she 
truly looked breathtaking.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today. ...Truly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will cherish Trainer's "tiara." Fufu, 
maybe I should turn it into dried flowers.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, first a photo before that! While it 
still looks pretty—...
(*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. It really is proof that belongs 
only to me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...So, um. About our next race."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay if I made the Shuka Sho 
my goal?

Autumn... the final leg of the Triple 
Tiara. If it's 2000m, with training from 
now on, it's certainly within reach, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep moving forward like this. I 
want to seize it! My very own path, my 
very own brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I can truly... ...truly accomplish what 
lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, will you... make 
another 'tiara' just for me?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want yours, Trainer! ...I want what 
you're having.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! I'm really gonna go for 
it! Trainer!
